description: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values for three different measurements across layers, with the threshold set at 1e-2. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5, and is labeled "Layer". The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and is labeled "Sparsity Ratio". The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing the sparsity ratio before gating, with an average value of 0.03; an orange dotted line with triangular markers representing the sparsity ratio after gating, with an average value of 0.44; and a green dashed line with star markers representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate, with an average value of 0.33. The blue line starts at approximately 0.2 and remains near 0.0 throughout. The orange line begins near 1.0 and decreases to approximately 0.2 before fluctuating between 0.1 and 0.4. The green line begins near 1.0 and decreases to approximately 0.1 before fluctuating between 0.1 and 0.2.
